pk-muslim-league.title: Flag of the All-India Muslim League

colors.note: Islam and the All-India Muslim League.

desc: - The All-India Muslim League flag (1937–1947) was a green field with white crescent and star — the direct precursor to the flag of Pakistan
- **Construction:** a dark green field with a white crescent and star — the flag of the All-India Muslim League, which became the basis for the Pakistan national flag
trivia:
- The All-India Muslim League flag represented Muslim political aspirations in British India
- Led the movement for Pakistan's creation
- Muhammad Ali Jinnah was the league's most prominent leader

east-pakistan.title: Flag of East Pakistan
desc: - East Pakistan (1947–1971) used the same flag as Pakistan. After the Liberation War of 1971, it became the independent nation of Bangladesh
- **Construction:** a dark green field with a white crescent and star (the Pakistan flag), sometimes with a gold map of East Bengal added in the centre during the autonomy movement
trivia:
- East Pakistan (1947–1971) became Bangladesh after the Bangladesh Liberation War
- The flag represented the eastern portion of the partition of India
- East and West Pakistan shared the same national flag despite geographic separation
